name: Collateral Date 2
definition: Dates related to the triparty collateral instruction or transactions.

TradeDate.name: Trade Date
TradeDate.definition: Date the transaction was agreed between the trading parties.

RequestedExecutionDate.name: Requested Execution Date
RequestedExecutionDate.definition: Date/time at which the instructing party requests the instruction to be executed.

SettlementDate.name: Settlement Date
SettlementDate.definition: Date on which the financial instruments are to be delivered or received.

RequestedExecutionDatePresenceRule.definition: If requested execution date is not present then trade date or settlement date must be present.

TradeDatePresenceRule.definition: If trade date is not present than requested execution date or settlement date must be present.

SettlementDatePresenceRule.definition: If settlement date is not present than trade date or requested execution date must be present.
